requirement: Soft delete an antibiotic group: load the live record, refuse the delete when a live sub-group or a live antibiotic still references it, and reject an unknown, empty, or already-deleted ID as not found.

preconditions.text: A live antibiotic group exists for the target ID
No live sub-group and no live antibiotic references the target group
A live sub-group references the target group
A live antibiotic references the target group
The target ID does not match any live group, or the group is already soft-deleted

inputs.text: Delete request for a leaf group that nothing points at
Delete request for a subgroup that nothing points at
Delete request for a group whose only references are soft-deleted
Delete request for a group with one live sub-group
Delete request for a group holding two live antibiotics
Delete request for a group referenced by both a sub-group and an antibiotic
Delete request with an unknown group ID
Delete request with Guid.Empty as the ID
Delete request for an already soft-deleted group

returns.text: Success with Deleted status; IsDeleted and DeletedAt are set on the target only
Failure with BusinessRuleViolation when a live group or antibiotic references the target
Failure with BadRequest when the target is missing, empty, or already deleted
No row is soft-deleted and no existing timestamp moves when the request fails

exception_text: No unhandled exception; every rejection is returned as a failed Result
